description: This file defines React components for an input group UI element, including subcomponents like addon, text, input, and textarea, with styling and interaction logic.

methods.name: InputGroup
methods.description: Main React component for grouping input elements with styling and role attributes.

methods.name: InputGroupAddon
methods.description: Subcomponent for adding elements (like icons or labels) to the input group with alignment options.

methods.name: InputGroupText
methods.description: Subcomponent for rendering inline text or icons within the input group.

methods.name: InputGroupInput
methods.description: Wrapper around Input component, styled as unstyled for use within input group.

methods.name: InputGroupTextarea
methods.description: Wrapper around Textarea component, styled as unstyled for use within input group.
